Require exactly one unified 0:: membership and /system.slice/slurmstepd.scope/job_<exactID>/step_<numericID>/user/task_0, bound to the exact SLURM_JOB_ID/SLURM_STEP_ID.
Require an unambiguous cgroup2 mount at /sys/fs/cgroup with root / and exact mountinfo identity. Capture the cgroup namespace metadata.

Capture complete lexical directory chain from /sys/fs/cgroup through system.slice/slurmstepd.scope/job/step/user/task; each path must be ordinary, root-owned and not group/other writable, with no symlink or escape. Record explicit absent/unreadable/error rows before rejecting.

Capture each own job/step/user/task cgroup.procs file literally with its hash and root-owned ordinary-file metadata. Require current PID exactly once in task membership. Do not require the PID in empty ancestor lists and do not inspect any other PID.
Recheck raw scheduler job and numeric-step UserId/JobId/StepId/state/node/resources against UID2618919, the same owned ledger, and explicit approved diagnostic shape.
